# Documentation index

*Generated by `scripts/gen-doc-index.py`. Do not edit by hand — your edits are overwritten on the next run, and `sandboxd/tests/test_doc_index.py` fails until it is re-run.*

**Grep this file, then read the one section.** Every entry carries its own `path:line`, so a grep hit is directly usable as `Read(path, offset=line, limit=60)` — the sections average 34 lines. Grepping here instead of across `docs/` is the difference between one hit with a line number and forty hits without.

It maps **headings, not content**: a fact stated in the middle of a section is not in here. Use it to find the right section, not to decide a topic is undocumented.

`docs/Project-definition.txt` is not indexed — it is not markdown. Runbooks `01`–`10` describe the nested Proxmox lab erased on 2026-08-28; their headings are indexed because they remain valid dated evidence, not because they describe this host.
